Title: Aditya's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Aditya - 12 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Anita - 41 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Savitri - 66 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses
4. Ananya - 11 years, daughter
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair
5. Zoya - 11 years, friend
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair

Places

1. The bathroom - a tap, a bucket, a mirror

Scene 1: The bathroom - Day

[Aditya stands in the bathroom. Anita, Ananya and Zoya stand near him.]

Anita: "Ananya, what's the plan today?"

[Aditya brushes his teeth at the sink.]

Aditya (surprised): "What happened?"

[Aditya takes a quick bath.]

Ananya: "That was such a fun day!"
